Pokémon GO Wild Area 2026: Sendai • Tohoku

Fri, Nov 6, 2026, 1:00 AM UTC → Sun, Nov 8, 2026, 9:00 AM UTC (the same moment worldwide)

An in-person ticketed GO Wild Area weekend in Sendai, Miyagi (Nov 6–8, 10 a.m.–6 p.m. local).

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

Featured

  • Gigantamax Duraludon and Dynamax Dialga and Palkia.
  • Hisuian Sliggoo; Hisuian Goodra debuts at the in-person events.
  • Mighty Lapras is Sendai's headline pick; mighty Machamp in a modern jacket, Bastiodon and Kommo-o appear at all in-person events.

Also

  • A Stamp Rally that has you exploring Miyagi Prefecture.

Tip

Can't travel? The Global weekend on Nov 14–15 shares many of the same headliners.
